a $1.05M private placement of common stock priced at $8.50 per share, more than 20% above its September 21 closing price of $7.07.

The placement was subscribed equally by BEN Capital Fund I and Joseph Bevash, with 123,650 shares to be issued. $150,025 was funded at closing, with the remaining $901,000 scheduled in five monthly installments through February 5, 2027.
Investors will receive 100% warrant coverage, with six-month warrants to purchase up to 123,650 additional shares at $8.50 if fully funded.
BEN said the deal continues its 2026 pattern of securing equity commitments at premiums to prevailing market prices.

title: Brand Engagement Network  announces $1.05M private placement
